contexts.text: By Divine omnipotence He could have subjugated...
Supposes that because He is omnipotent and omnipresent... He wills the evil of penalty... AC 8700:4.
The translators render Shaddai the Omnipotent, (or the Almighty)...
There is a communication between the Infinite and the finite by the Divine omnipotence.
When it treats of the Divine power or omnipotence of good, He is called Jehovah Zebaoth, and also Lord.
He is called Lord Jehovih especially when the aid of omnipotence is sought for. Illustrated.
Here, () Lord God Almighty is said instead of Jehovah Zebaoth, as in .

Behold a troop cometh, = in the supreme sense, omnipotence and omniscience... because a troop, here, means a multitude, and a multitude, when predicated of the Lord's Divine, is an infinite multitude, which is nothing else than omnipotence and omniscience; but omnipotence is predicated from the quantity of magnitude, and omniscience from the quantity of multitude; also, omnipotence is predicated from infinite good, or, what is the same, from the Divine love, thus from the Divine will; but omniscience from infinite truth, or, what is the same, from the Divine intelligence... The good of charity corresponds to the Lord's Divine omnipotence; and the truth of faith to His omniscience.
To sit at the right hand of God = a state of power through the truth which is from good, which, when predicated of the Lord, is omnipotence... AC 4933:end. AC 7281.
Gad, in the supreme sense, = omnipotence and omniscience.
A rod, like the hand, = power; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord's Divine omnipotence.
Through Angels the Lord could lead man into good ends with omnipotent force, but this would be to take life away from him...
Here the Lord is called a Lion from the omnipotence which belongs to His Divine love, and thence to His Divine truth. Illustrated.
From the hands of the mighty Jacob = from the omnipotence of the Lord's Divine Human. Explained.
The Spirits and Angels from one Earth are so few in respect to the omnipotence of God that they are scarcely anything.
The fallacy that the Lord can take away evil if He will, by omnipotence...
To put forth the hand = to show power, and, from omnipotence, to do it. This omnipotence is described by (the following words).
This (act of Joshua at Ai) was a representative of the Divine omnipotence. Further illustrated.
The acknowledgement of the Lord's omnipotence. Signified.
The Lord's omnipotence, that it was shown. Signified, Explained.
For it is Divine truth which has omnipotence from Divine good.
The effect of omnipotence upon evils and thence falsities. Signified, Explained.
From omnipotence. Signified.
The omnipotence which is in Divine truth. Signified. AC 8764:4. AC 9410:5.
To sit at the right hand of the power of God = the Divine omnipotence which will remain to eternity.
To sit at the right hand of power = that the Lord has omnipotence; for Divine good has omnipotence through Divine truth.
That the Divine truth was in its omnipotence when the Lord in the world had conquered the Hells, and had reduced into order all things there and in the Heavens. Signified.
Sit at My right hand = the omnipotence of Divine good through Divine truth, which the Lord then was, and from which He fought and conquered.

When the palms of the hands are predicated of the Lord, and of the Divine truth proceeding from His Divine good, omnipotence is signified; (thus there is here) signified the acknowledgement of the Lord's omnipotence...
Preface. There is to be published, Angelic Wisdom concerning the Divine Omnipotence, Omnipresence, Omniscience, Infinity, and Eternity. DLord 46:2. DSS 32. DLW 130:2. (See TCR 49. TCR 341:end.)

By the assumption of this Human the Lord put on the Divine omnipotence not only of subjugating the Hells, and of reducing into order the Heavens; but also of keeping the Hells subjugated to eternity, and of saving men.
That this One Only and Itself is omnipresent, omniscient, and omnipotent. Explained.
That to Him alone belong Divine majesty and Divine omnipotence to eternity. Signified.
The Almighty () = who is, lives, and has power, from Himself; and who rules all things from primes through ultimates. Explained. AR 522, Signified. AR 663.
To whom alone belongs the omnipotence of saving. Signified, Explained.
Having seven horns = His omnipotence. AE 316.
That to the Lord as to the Divine Human belong omnipotence, omniscience, Divine good, and Divine truth. Signified.
By the Lord God Almighty () is meant the Lord from eternity, who is Jehovah Himself.
Concerning the omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence of God. Chapter.

These three proceed from the Divine love and the Divine wisdom scarcely otherwise than as the power and presence of the sun (do) through the heat and light... (Thus) as infinity, immensity, and eternity pertain to the Divine Esse, so do omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence to the Divine Essence.
That omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence are of the Divine wisdom from the Divine love. General article.
That the omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence of God cannot be Known unless it is Known what order is... General article.
That the omnipotence of God, both in the universe and in each and all things of it, proceeds and operates according to the laws of His order. General article.
(Thus) His omnipotence proceeds and operates within the sphere of the extension of good, which is infinite...
(Thus) the Divine omnipotence cannot possibly from itself go out to contact with anything evil, nor promote it from itself; for evil averts itself...

(The idea) that the omnipotence of God is like the absolute power of a king... From this absurd opinion... concerning the Divine omnipotence, as many falsities... have inflowed into the Church, as there are changes... therein... what need is there of more than the two words, omnipotence and faith...

If the extension of the Divine omnipotence were equally to do evil as to do good, what difference would there be between God and the devil?... Who is not able to know that good and evil are opposites, and that if God from His omnipotence could will both... He could do nothing at all. Explained.
(Argument showing the absurdity of the idea that) the omnipotence of God is absolute for doing evil as well as good.

As the universe is the fulness of God, by omnipresence He perceives all things; by omniscience He provides all things; and by omnipotence He operates all things. Whence it is evident that omnipresence, omniscience, and omnipotence make a one; or that the one implies the other; and thus that they cannot be separated.
That man is in power against evil and falsity from the Divine omnipotence... in proportion as he lives according to Divine order. General article.

No one can act against this monstrous giant, or Hell, except God, because He is omnipotent; from which it is evident that man, unless he goes to the omnipotent God, has no power (whatever) against the evil and falsity thence... TCR 68:2.
(An argument in favour of imputation and predestination, based on the omnipotence of God. Refuted by one of the simple good.)

(Some of them come to Swedenborg, and ask), What is the Divine omnipotence, if it is tied to laws? (Seeing their mental distress, he explains the subject to them by reference to the laws of order.) (A second long argument on the same subject. TCR 74.)
Jehovah, such as Ho is in Himself, from His omnipotence cannot touch any devil... unless He is in ultimates...
Therefore the omnipotence of God in the universe... proceeds and operates according to the laws of His Divine order. Explained. TCR 90.
I have seen, and do see every day, the Divine omnipotence of the Lord in (reducing all things in Heaven and Hell into order).
By to sit at the right hand is meant the omnipotence of God by means of the Human which He assumed in the world...
This is contrary to order, and consequently contrary to His omnipotence, which cannot proceed except by the way of justice; and the laws of justice are Truths, which cannot be changed.
(Argument concerning omnipotence and freewill.)
The man who through falsities... has become natural, cannot think of the Divine omnipotence except as being above order, and thus as apart from order. (This idea refuted by a reductio ad absurdum.)
When they name faith and omnipotence, reason is exiled.
They wondered that by the omnipotence of God they are not reduced into the state that they can be Angels. Explained.
Concerning the omnipotence of the Lord.
Who is the Almighty () = from Himself. Explained.
Almighty () = that He is infinite. Explained.
The Lord as to omnipotence, and as to omniscience. Signified, Explained.
That the right hand, when predicated of the Lord, = both omnipotence and omniscience. Explained, Illustrated.
The omnipotence of the Lord from Divine good through Divine truth. Signified, Illustrated.
That from the Divine Human the Lord has omnipotence and omniscience. Signified.
The primary thing is to acknowledge the Lord... and His omnipotence to save the human race...

The Lord so often said, Be it according to thy faith, in order that they should first believe that from the Divine Human He had Divine omnipotence; for without this faith the Church could not be commenced, and without it they would not be conjoined with the Divine; but would be separated from it; and thus they could receive nothing of good from Him.
That to Him belong omnipotence, omniscience, and the Divine Providence. Signified, Explained.
That to Him alone belongs omnipotence, to eternity. Signified, Explained.
More than (the twelve legions of Angels) = the Divine omnipotence.
Omnipotence from Divine good through Divine truth. Signified, Explained.
The Divine omnipotence of the Lord over the Heavens and over the earth. Signified. AE 687:10.
We give Thee thanks, Lord God Almighty () = the acknowledgement that all being, life, and ability are from the Lord.

The Divine omnipotence does not involve anything of power to act against order; but it involves all power to act according to order; for all order is from Him... (Thus) it is of the Divine omnipotence to lead man according to order, and this every moment from the beginning of his life to eternity; and this according to the laws of order, which are innumerable; but this only in proportion as man suffers himself to be led... And, as it is of the Divine omnipotence to lead according to order the man who wants to be led, consequently not anyone contrary to order, therefore it is not of the Divine omnipotence to lead anyone to Heaven who wants to lead himself. Explained... (Thus) it is not of the Divine omnipotence to save those who do not want to be led according to order; for to be led according to order, is to be led according to the laws of order; and the laws of order are the precepts of doctrine and of life from the Word; and therefore to lead according to these, every moment and continually to eternity, the man who wants to be led, is of the Divine omnipotence; for there are infinite things every minute which must be seen, which must be removed, and which must be insinuated, in order that the man may be withheld from evils, and be held in goods; and these constantly in connection according to order. It is also of the Divine omnipotence to protect men from the Hells, in so far as this can be done without injury to freedom and reason; for against the Divine power of the Lord all the Hells are as nothing. Without this power of the Lord no man can be saved.
As the Lord has omnipotence from Divine good through Divine truth, miracles were performed by the ark...
The Lord is now in His fulness, and thus in His omnipotence in the earth as in the Heavens, because He is in ultimates and in primes.
From the Divine omnipotence and Providence. Signified, Explained.

Lord God Almighty () = because He is Divine good; (for) omnipotence = to be, to come forth, to be able, and to live, from Himself... And as He has omnipotence from Divine good through Divine truth, it is said Lord God Almighty. AE 979.
That the Lord is good itself and truth itself, and thence omnipotent. Signified, Explained.
As the Lord acts all things from Divine good through Divine truth, by Lord of lords and King of kings is also meant the Lord as omnipotent.
Who has omnipotence, as in the Heavens, so also on earth. Signified, Explained.
As God is infinite. He is also omnipotent; for omnipotence is infinite power. The omnipotence of God shines forth from the universe... Explained.
To resist the evils with man is of the Divine omnipotence, the Divine omniscience, and the Divine Providence. Explained.
It is said Lord God Almighty (), because the Lord is called... almighty from the separation of the good from the evil by the Last Judgment; and also from the power to save those who receive Him.
God 10. Through His proceeding Divine, God has omnipotence, omnipresence, and omniscience.
God. 8. Concerning the omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence of God.
God. 8. 10. The conservation of the universe, which is perpetual creation, is a full testimony that God is omnipotent, omniscient, and omnipresent.

God. 8. The Divine omnipotence is through His Human... CanonsNC 21. Redeemer. 8. 6. By the union of this Human with His Divine, Jehovah God exalted His omnipotence, which is meant by to sit at the right hand of God.
That the universal theology of the present day is nothing else than the Divine omnipotence. Explained.
The correspondences by which the Word is written possess such a force and virtue that it may be called the force and virtue of the Divine omnipotence...
